head: codex/5590-runtime-v3-parity-d
title: [v0.91.8][WP-14][runtime-v3][parity-d] Prove secure access, Observatory, guardian, and rollback
body:
Closes #5590

Completes Runtime v3 Parity-D with one configuration-driven HTTPS access model, bearer-protected HTTP and WSS Observatory feeds, actual listener discovery, an external guardian executable, Vector-owned telemetry boundaries, and operational candidate-to-prior rollback. The selector serializes transitions and uses instance-owned stop receipts instead of externally signaling stored PIDs; replacement waits for guardian descendant cleanup. Live WebSockets are revoked after token rotation and the browser downgrades state on close.

FastWork proof passed: complete Runtime v3 kernel tests, strict kernel Clippy, 127 adl-runtime tests plus guardian and independence tests, four Observatory WebSocket tests, selector adversarial tests, HTML Observatory integration, and an external guardian rollback proof that cryptographically restores both candidate and prior signed continuity lineages. Exact remediation review verified all six findings fixed with zero blockers.

Runtime v3 measures 12,842 physical lines and 199 tests. The reviewer accepted the necessary, nonduplicative +159-line remediation over the prior reviewed point; a SIGKILL during selector transition may leave a stale lock that fails closed and requires operator recovery. No AWS, Runtime v2, plaintext access, hard-coded IP, sidecar, or custom OTel path is included.
